comments.body:
As someone who suffers from Anxiety/OCD and studies physics at ETH, I can totally relate to you. I'm still struggling with it myself, it's not easy, but I can try to give you two tips:

Firstly, try to find a good therapist if it is financially possible. If it's not financially possible, then definitely go to the ETH office. My tips are certainly not on the level of professionals.

Tipp 1. try your best! I mean, if you've given it your all and maybe can't finish your studies, then you can't blame yourself. We have another burden that we have to carry every day, but it shouldn't stop you from turning your dream into reality. Everyone has problems that they have to deal with, the trick is to make the best of them.

Tipp 2. don't be too hard on yourself. There may be days when you can't do much because you're feeling worse. That's okay. It doesn't mean you have to stop your studies because of it. As I said in (1), just do your best! 

Tipp 3. this is a rather sensitive topic and I don't want to persuade anyone. But what also helps me personally is medication. It's important to mention here that of course you need to talk to a professional about this. I really don't want to talk up medications here, because ultimately they also have disadvantages (namely side effects) and you have to weigh up for yourself whether the pros are better than the cons. So if this is an option for you, I can recommend it. However, if you don't want to do this then you can manage without it. It's just another help.

If you want to write or talk somehow you can always write me on private messages :). I wish you every success in your fight against OCD! You've got this and you certainly don't have to quit your studies!!! :)
comments.author: KeyLab3958
